timing_caveat: Marker/profile spans are wall observations, not exclusive CPU time. Phase maxima are2m Python,12m JVM,6m lint/native inside the unchanged20m outer job; they do not guarantee all phases plus artifacts fit. Installed ordinary app budget remains180s.
limits: API35 installed regression coverage only; the new Help-specific tests are API30/35 JVM/Robolectric configurations, not installed Help-specific device coverage. No native-speaker, full-language, physical-device, TalkBack or general layout acceptance.

archive.includes: All JUnit identities/XML, lint reports, phase logs and local profiles, all installed invocation/restart records, job logs and artifact inventories. Rendered previews and system logcat are inventoried rather than duplicated.

apk_verification_limit: APK/source metadata and successful CI identity/extraction logs are retained; binary archive was not separately downloaded or independently unpacked. Report archives were independently SHA256-verified.
